title: Dashboard bug fixes
body:
* **Single-field filter default**: Changing the field on a single-field filter now clears the previous field's default value. The filter falls back to **All**, or to **None** when **All** isn't allowed.
* **Widget-level filter refresh**: The values in widget-level filters now refresh when a dataset changes, without a browser refresh. See [Filter on fields](/aws/en/dashboards/manage/filters/field-filters).
* **Custom theme scope**: Custom themes no longer color the **View queries** dialog, widget context menus, or data reference popovers, matching the behavior of built-in themes.
* **Funnel chart fields**: Fields now carry over when you change a chart to or from a funnel chart. See [Funnel chart](/aws/en/dashboards/manage/visualizations/types#funnel).
* **Tabbed editor popover height**: Tabbed editor popovers now keep their opening height instead of growing.
